svg.title: OVER-03 — Compact final scoreboard
svg.desc: 1280 by 900 client. A short completed local result uses the actual interim-style content-sized centered panel, a single score strip, column headings and three player rows. No large enclosing final window, descriptive hierarchy or empty network footer. Required final progress and End of Game remain separate below the panel. Dimensions and values illustrate relationships; the appearance owner and actual OVER-02 metrics are normative.

g.text: ANNOTATIONS — not UI. Retained final arena and dark-red curtain; outlined score surfaces use actual OVER-02 translucency.
Content-sized and client-centered when it fits. One strip; no extra title, scope/outcome/ranking captions or first-column heading.
Same 32 px table rhythm, colors, formatting, padding and strip overhang as interim; no added surrounding window.
Only overflow adds bounded navigation/feedback. Team rows stay adjacent, with existing 8 px bands and centered 2 px rules.
Final counter and completion cue have 16 px gaps. Local exit/timing/input ownership are unchanged; no blank role-action allocation.
